hero.title: Safer email. <brand>Start with your domain.</brand>
hero.text: Check your domain for free, keep a setup checklist, and work through SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI. Get help from Kastro when you need someone to handle the setup.

live.label: Live DNS lookup
live.detail: Your domain is sent to Kastro Lookup to assess its public DNS records.

beta.label: Real-world review
beta.detail: Kastro can review actual DNS evidence and scope the right remediation work.

operator.label: For your email provider
operator.detail: Kastro verifies DNS changes before they go live.

target.label: DMARC target
target.detail: Progress through monitor, quarantine, reject without breaking legitimate mail.

threat.title: Your name should only speak for you.
threat.text: A familiar sender is not always a trusted sender. Explore how an enforced DMARC policy helps receiving mail servers reject impersonation.

workflow.title: From public records to informed decisions.
workflow.text: Check published SPF and DMARC configuration, then verify legitimate senders and reporting before changing enforcement.

discover.title: Discover
discover.detail: Check public DNS records, then add your domain to a checklist saved in this browser.

stabilize.title: Stabilize
stabilize.detail: Review every sending service, remove obsolete SPF entries only after verification, and enable DKIM at each provider.

enforce.title: Enforce
enforce.detail: Advance DMARC from none to quarantine to reject with report-backed confidence.

ladder.title: The enforcement ladder
ladder.detail: Most domains never leave the first rung.
ladder.reject: p=reject — request rejection of unauthenticated mail

features.title: Four standards. Practical next steps.
features.text: Use the free check and setup checklist at your own pace. Dmark does not publish or change DNS records for you.

spf.title: SPF
spf.detail: Review authorized senders, duplicate records and the 10-lookup limit. Clean up unnecessary includes with evidence; Dmark does not offer hosted SPF flattening.

dkim.title: DKIM
dkim.detail: Enable signing at each sending service. Check a selector from your provider or a message header, then verify real signed messages.

dmarc.title: DMARC
dmarc.detail: Inventory senders and review aggregate reports before tightening enforcement. Use an existing reporting service, including Cloudflare where available.

bimi.title: BIMI
bimi.detail: An optional branding step after authentication. Check the default BIMI record and review logo, enforcement and certificate requirements. Certificates may cost money; logo display is not guaranteed.

footer_cta.title: Put your name behind every email.

footer.text: A free email security tool from Kastro. SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI guidance, with optional setup assistance.

steps.detail: A monitoring policy does not request rejection for DMARC failures. Other receiver protections still apply.

steps.title: A familiar name can look convincing
steps.detail: Your logo, your name, your customer — a convincing invoice or password reset.

footer.title: DMARC helps protect your domain.
footer.text: Dmark helps you understand the settings. Confirm legitimate senders and alignment before moving to enforcement; DMARC does not stop every form of phishing.

Workspace.text: Keep a free checklist for each domain and return to the live check whenever you change a record.

senders.title: List every legitimate sender
senders.detail: Include staff email, invoices, newsletters, CRM, website forms, ticketing and devices. Confirm who owns each service and which domain it signs with.

spf.title: Review SPF
spf.detail: Use one SPF record for the domain, include only verified senders, and stay within the 10-lookup limit. Get record values from your providers. Never replace a live record with a generic example.

dkim.title: Enable and verify DKIM
dkim.detail: Publish the TXT or CNAME entries supplied by each sending service, then enable signing there. Find the selector in the provider settings or s= in a message header. Check an actual message for dkim=pass and an aligned d= domain.

reports.title: Review DMARC reports
reports.detail: Choose a report service or mailbox you control. Confirm external reporting authorization where required. Review legitimate and unknown senders across a representative business cycle. Dmark does not receive or host aggregate reports in this release.

dmarc.title: Plan DMARC enforcement
dmarc.detail: For a new setup, monitor before enforcing. Preserve any existing protection while checking senders. DMARC passes when aligned SPF or aligned DKIM succeeds. Progress toward quarantine or reject only after real mail and reports support the change; include subdomain policy in the review.

bimi.title: Optional: prepare BIMI
bimi.detail: BIMI adds branding, not a replacement for authentication. Review DMARC enforcement, a compliant SVG logo served over HTTPS, and the receiving provider’s VMC/CMC requirements. Certificates may cost money and inbox display depends on the provider. The scanner checks default._bimi only and does not validate the logo or certificate.
